mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, COM_NAME, COM_INFO, COM_NUM, COM_EMAIL, COM_URL, COM_CREATE_YEAR, COM_MEM, COM_LOGO, COM_PAYMENT, INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM COMPANY
SELECT COMPANY_REVIEW_NO , COM_ID , JOB_CODE , WORKING_YN , COMPANY_REVIEW_STATUS , COMPANY_REVIEW_ONE_LINE , USER_ID , STATUS FROM COMPANY_REVIEW WHERE COMPANY_REVIEW_NO = #{companyReviewNo}
SELECT COMPANY_REVIEW_NO , COM_ID , JOB_CODE , WORKING_YN , COMPANY_REVIEW_STATUS , COMPANY_REVIEW_ONE_LINE , USER_ID , STATUS FROM COMPANY_REVIEW

SELECT cr.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO, cr.COM_ID, c.COM_NAME, c.COM_INFO, cr.JOB_CODE, cr.WORKING_YN, cr.COMPANY_REVIEW_STATUS, cr.COMPANY_REVIEW_ONE_LINE, cr.USER_ID, cr.STATUS FROM TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY_REVIEW cr JOIN TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY c ON cr.COM_ID = c.USER_ID WHERE cr.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY cr.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO

SELECT c.USER_ID, c.COM_NAME, r.COM_ID, r.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO, r.JOB_CODE, r.WORKING_YN, r.COMPANY_REVIEW_STATUS, r.COMPANY_REVIEW_ONE_LINE, r.USER_ID, q.COMPANY_REVIEW_QUESTION_NO, q.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO, q.REVIEW_SUBJECT_CODE, q.COMPANY_REVIEW_SCORE FROM TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY c INNER JOIN TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY_REVIEW r ON c.USER_ID = r.COM_ID INNER JOIN COMPANY_REVIEW_QUESTION q ON r.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO = q.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO WHERE c.USER_ID = #{comId} ORDER BY r.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO, q.COMPANY_REVIEW_QUESTION_NO
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'CPRV'|| LPAD(NVL(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MAX(COMPANY_REVIEW_NO), LENGTH('CPRV' ) + 1)), 0) + 1, 6, '0') FROM COMPANY_REVIEW
INSERT INTO COMPANY_REVIEW ( COMPANY_REVIEW_NO, COM_ID, JOB_CODE, WORKING_YN, COMPANY_REVIEW_STATUS, COMPANY_REVIEW_ONE_LINE, USER_ID, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{companyReviewNo}, #{comId}, #{jobCode}, #{workingYn}, #{companyReviewStatus}, #{companyReviewOneLine}, #{userId}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMPANY_REVIEW SET STATUS = 'Y' WHERE COMPANY_REVIEW_NO = #{companyReviewNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT C.USER_ID AS COM_ID, C.COM_NAME AS COMPANY_NAME, C.COM_LOGO AS COMPANY_LOGO, C.COM_INFO AS COM_INFO, C.COM_MAIN_BIZ AS COM_MAIN_BIZ, C.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS INDUSTRY_TYPE, IC.INDU_NAME AS INDU_NAME, C.COM_MEM AS COM_MEM, C.COM_SIZE AS COM_SIZE, CS.CODE_NAME AS COM_SIZE_NAME, C.CEO_NAME AS CEO_NAME, COUNT(CR.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO) AS TOTAL_REVIEW_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN CR.WORKING_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WORKING_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN CR.WORKING_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOT_WORKING_COUNT
FROM COMPANY C
LEFT JOIN COMPANY_REVIEW CR ON C.USER_ID = CR.COM_ID
LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.CMN_CODE CS ON C.COM_SIZE = CS.CODE_DETAIL_NO AND CS.CODE_DETAIL_NO = C.COM_SIZE
LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.INDU_CODE IC ON C.INDUSTRY_TYPE = IC.INDU_NO
WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId}
GROUP BY C.USER_ID, C.COM_NAME, C.COM_LOGO, C.COM_INFO, C.COM_MAIN_BIZ, C.INDUSTRY_TYPE, IC.INDU_NAME, C.COM_MEM, C.COM_SIZE, CS.CODE_NAME, C.CEO_NAME
SELECT ROUND(AVG(q.company_review_score),1) FROM company_review cr JOIN company_review_question q ON cr.company_review_no = q.company_review_no WHERE cr.com_id = #{comId}

SELECT q.review_subject_code AS reviewSubjectCode, c.code_name AS reviewSubjectName, ROUND(AVG(q.company_review_score),1) AS avgScore FROM company_review cr JOIN company_review_question q ON cr.company_review_no = q.company_review_no JOIN cmn_code c ON q.review_subject_code = c.code_detail_no WHERE cr.com_id = #{comId} GROUP BY q.review_subject_code, c.code_name ORDER BY q.review_subject_code

SELECT j.top_job_code AS topJobCode, tj.top_job_name AS topJobName, ROUND(AVG(q.company_review_score), 1) AS topJobOverallAvg FROM company_review cr JOIN company_review_question q ON cr.company_review_no = q.company_review_no JOIN job j ON cr.job_code = j.job_code JOIN top_job tj ON j.top_job_code = tj.top_job_code WHERE cr.com_id = #{comId} GROUP BY j.top_job_code, tj.top_job_name ORDER BY j.top_job_code

SELECT j.top_job_code AS topJobCode, q.review_subject_code AS reviewSubjectCode, c.code_name AS reviewSubjectName, ROUND(AVG(q.company_review_score), 1) AS avgScore FROM company_review cr JOIN company_review_question q ON cr.company_review_no = q.company_review_no JOIN job j ON cr.job_code = j.job_code JOIN cmn_code c ON q.review_subject_code = c.code_detail_no WHERE cr.com_id = #{comId} GROUP BY j.top_job_code, q.review_subject_code, c.code_name ORDER BY j.top_job_code, q.review_subject_code

SELECT C.USER_ID AS USER_ID, C.COM_NAME AS COM_NAME, C.COM_NUM AS COM_NUM, C.COM_MEM AS COM_MEM, C.COM_LOGO AS COM_LOGO, C.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS COM_INDU_TYPE, IC.INDU_NAME AS INDU_NAME, NVL(R.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_REVIEW_COUNT, NVL(R.AVG_SCORE, 0) AS OVERALL_AVG_SCORE, NVL(R.REVIEW_USER_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_USER_COUNT,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RN WHERE RN.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND RN.RECRUIT_FINISH_YN = 'N' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_RECRUITING
FROM TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY C
LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.INDU_CODE IC ON C.INDUSTRY_TYPE = IC.INDU_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CR.COM_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT CR.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO) AS REVIEW_COUNT, ROUND(AVG(Q.COMPANY_REVIEW_SCORE), 1) AS AVG_SCORE, COUNT(DISTINCT CR.USER_ID) AS REVIEW_USER_COUNT FROM TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY_REVIEW CR LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY_REVIEW_QUESTION Q ON CR.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO = Q.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO GROUP BY CR.COM_ID ) R ON C.USER_ID = R.COM_ID
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY_REVIEW R2 WHERE R2.COM_ID = C.USER_ID )
ORDER BY C.COM_NAME
